summaryZh: Nano-bio-imaging and Devices Laboratory 对应的 Lal 负责人介绍研究通道与受体的多尺度生物物理和系统生物学，并开发生物医学诊断与治疗纳米器件。实验室开发融合原子力显微镜、光镊、电记录和单分子显微术的 Smart AFM，也研究纳米传感器及 BioMEMS。
researchQuestions: 通道与受体的结构和功能如何关联，纳米技术如何用于诊疗？

evidence.quote: Research in his lab involves the development of nanotechnologies for and multi-scale biophysical and system biology studies of channels and receptors.
designing multimodal "Smart AFM" integrating AFM, Optical Tweezers, electrical recording, and single molecule microscopy
designing nanodevices and BioMEMs for array-based screening of therapeutics and their delivery and tissue engineering.
